final_answer:
**Bottom line:** %CAR+ passed PPQ-001 on all five batches. The ULT freezer excursion on 2026-04-20 is still unresolved. It degraded vector lot LV25-118, and the open deviation (DEV-26-027) blames donor variability for the resulting low %CAR+. That explanation isn't supported by the data. A pending change control (CC-26-022) would raise MOI to a value outside the PPQ range.

%CAR+ is the release test FC-CAR, a CQA. Don't confuse it with the day-5 in-process read (`car_pos_pct`).

## 1. Process parameters that drive it
These are the parameters linked to %CAR+ in the semantic layer.

| Parameter | Type | PPQ-001 limit | Linked risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| MOI (target) | CPP | 4.0–6.0 TU/cell | FM-06 |
| Time from activation to transduction | CPP | 20–30 h | FM-08 |
| Vector storage temperature | KPP | none (no PPQ criterion) | FM-07 |

## 2. Risks that threaten it
All four are in RA-PFMEA-001.

| Risk | Class | Sev | Failure mode |
|---|---|---|---|
| FM-06 | HIGH | 8 | MOI below target. Cause: titer over-estimated or vector degraded. |
| FM-07 | HIGH | 8 | Vector held above -70 °C. Cause: ULT freezer failure. |
| FM-15 | HIGH | 10 | OOS result not flagged. |
| FM-08 | MEDIUM | 6 | Transduction outside 20–30 h. |

## 3. Controls and test evidence

**FM-06 (MOI below target)**
- It is mitigated by URS-EBR-007 (vector volume calculated from target MOI and CoA titer) and by SOP-MFG-104.
- URS-EBR-007 is a HIGH-risk requirement (FRA-040).
- It is verified by TC-OQ-EBR-04 (SCRIPTED) through CS-EBR-02. The test passed on 2026-03-17 (TX-0083), and no change control has touched it.
- **Gap:** the control relies on the CoA titer. If the vector loses potency, the effective MOI drops and nothing in the batch record shows it.

**FM-07 (vector held above -70 °C)**
- It is mitigated by URS-ULT-001 (hold ≤ -70 °C), URS-ULT-002 (high-temperature alarm), URS-EMS-014 (alarm escalation within 15 minutes) and SOP-MAT-401.
- All three requirements are HIGH risk.
- URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002 are verified on both freezers.
  - After the FRZ-80-02 compressor change (CC-26-014, 2026-04-23), the pull-down and alarm tests were re-run and passed on 2026-04-24 (TX-0091, TX-0092).
  - The loaded PQ (TC-PQ-ULT-01, FRZ-80-02, 2026-02-12) predates the compressor change and was not repeated.
- **Gap: URS-EMS-014 has a stale verification.**
  - Its only test is TC-OQ-EMS-04 (TX-0070, 2026-01-20).
  - CC-26-011 changed the paging provider and rebuilt the escalation recipients (CS-EMS-03) on 2026-03-16.
  - That change control was assessed as "no re-testing required", so the test predates it.
- There is also no direct test on URS-EMS-014 itself. Its evidence comes only through CS-EMS-03.

**FM-15 (OOS not flagged)**
- It is mitigated by URS-LIMS-002 and URS-LIMS-003, both HIGH risk.
- Both are verified through CS-LIMS-02 and CS-LIMS-01, with SCRIPTED tests passed on 2026-02-09 and 2026-02-10 (TX-0074, TX-0075).
- There is no change control on the LIMS.

**FM-08 (transduction timing)**
- **Gap:** it has no requirement and no test evidence.
- It is mitigated only by SOP-MFG-104 and a batch-record timing check.
- This is the only one of the four risks with no verified requirement behind it.

## 4. How it is measured and validated
- **Method:** AM-FC-CAR, CAR expression by flow cytometry, status VALIDATED, validated range 5–90 % of CD3+.
- **Validation protocol:** AMV-FC-CAR-01 was approved on 2026-03-02, with its report approved.
- **Test evidence:** TC-AMV-CAR-01 (SCRIPTED) was executed on 2026-03-20 as TX-0086 and passed.
- **Range check:** the PPQ limit (≥ 20 %) and all observed results sit inside the validated range.
- **Related quantity:** VCN per CAR+ cell is calculated in LIMS as VCN-DDPCR divided by %CAR+. The ddPCR method is AM-VCN.

## 5. PPQ performance (PPQ-001, criterion 8: ≥ 20 % of CD3+)

| Batch | %CAR+ | Vector lot | MOI | Hours to transduction | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PPQ26-01 | 44.6 | LV26-007 | 5.0 | 23.3 | PASS |
| PPQ26-02 | 39.2 | LV26-007 | 5.0 | 23.7 | PASS |
| PPQ26-03 | 36.1 | LV26-007 | 5.0 | 21.9 | PASS |
| PPQ26-04 | 38.9 | LV26-021 | 5.0 | 22.0 | PASS |
| PPQ26-05 | 37.3 | LV26-021 | 5.0 | 21.9 | PASS |

- The mean is 39.2 % and the range is 36.1–44.6 %.
- VCN per CAR+ cell was 1.79–2.39, against a limit of ≤ 5.0.
- All MOI and timing CPP values were inside their ranges.
- Both PPQ vector lots were stored in FRZ-80-01. Its historian readings stayed between -82.3 and -78.1 °C.
- The PPQ-001 report is still pending (status: execution complete, report pending).

## 6. Related deviations and what connects them
**The vector-potency chain**
1. Freezer FRZ-80-02 stopped on 2026-04-20.
   - The alarm started at 03:20 and was acknowledged at 14:40, after about 11 hours. That is far beyond the 15-minute escalation in URS-EMS-014.
   - The historian shows the chamber warming from -67 °C at 04:00 to about -36 °C at 15:00 (when the contents were moved) and about -12 °C by 22 April.
   - The stale EMS escalation verification (CC-26-011) is the likely link to the late acknowledgement. That link is my inference, not a stated root cause.
2. DEV-26-021, with CAPA-26-008 and CC-26-014, covers the compressor. The CAPA is closed and effective.
   - The deviation record says "no lots placed on hold".
   - Its impact assessment cites a supplier stability limit of ≤ -65 °C, and the recorded excursion went well above that.
   - It has no link to the vector lot.
3. Vector lot LV25-118 was in FRZ-80-02 at the time (material_lot still lists the freezer as its location). It is still RELEASED.
4. %CAR+ with LV25-118:
   - Before the excursion, 11 PD batches (PD26-014 to PD26-023, 34.5–41.3 %).
   - After it, PD26-024 to PD26-027 gave 14.9–17.3 %, and ENG26-01, -02 and -03 gave 19.8, 11.9 and 13.9 %. All three ENG runs were NONCONFORMING (INFO).
   - VCN-DDPCR dropped to about 0.14–0.27, against about 0.8 normally.
   - The other lots (LV25-104, LV26-007, LV26-021) were unaffected.
   - The CoA titer (104 million TU/mL) was not updated, so the calculated vector volume overstated the real MOI.

**The deviation that points the wrong way**
- DEV-26-027 (open, atypical result) covers ENG26-01 and ENG26-02 only, not ENG26-03.
- It attributes the low %CAR+ to "donor variability (low CD3%)".
  - Apheresis CD3 was 65.3 % and 63.8 % for those two batches, which is normal.
  - ENG26-03 was lower at 50.9 %, but it is not in the deviation.
  - PD26-024 and PD26-025 used the same donor as ENG26-02 (HD-0105) and also gave low %CAR+, yet that donor's earlier PD batches did not. Both facts fit the vector explanation rather than the donor one.
- It is linked only to CAPA-26-016, which evaluates a minimum apheresis CD3 criterion.
- Nothing in the data links DEV-26-027 to DEV-26-021, LV25-118 or FRZ-80-02.

**Change control CC-26-022 (in impact assessment)**
- It proposes raising the target MOI from 5.0 to 8.0 TU/cell, to improve %CAR+, via SOP-MFG-104.
- That is outside the PPQ-001 CPP range of 4–6 and would need requalification.
- It is also premised on the wrong cause.

**Other PPQ deviations**
- DEV-26-033, DEV-26-038 and DEV-26-041 relate to PPQ batches but not to %CAR+.
- DEV-26-033 is a harvest viability protocol deviation on PPQ26-02.
- DEV-26-038 is a label printer error.
- DEV-26-041 is a tubing leak and is still open.

## Recommended actions
- Place LV25-118 on hold and re-titer it.
- Link DEV-26-027 to DEV-26-021 and reopen the root cause.
- Re-verify URS-EMS-014.
- Add a requirement and test evidence for FM-08.
- Hold CC-26-022 until the cause is settled.

content.text:
**Bottom line:** %CAR+ passed PPQ-001 on all five batches. The ULT freezer excursion on 2026-04-20 is still unresolved. It degraded vector lot LV25-118, and the open deviation (DEV-26-027) blames donor variability for the resulting low %CAR+. That explanation isn't supported by the data. A pending change control (CC-26-022) would raise MOI to a value outside the PPQ range.

%CAR+ is the release test FC-CAR, a CQA. Don't confuse it with the day-5 in-process read (`car_pos_pct`).

## 1. Process parameters that drive it
These are the parameters linked to %CAR+ in the semantic layer.

| Parameter | Type | PPQ-001 limit | Linked risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| MOI (target) | CPP | 4.0–6.0 TU/cell | FM-06 |
| Time from activation to transduction | CPP | 20–30 h | FM-08 |
| Vector storage temperature | KPP | none (no PPQ criterion) | FM-07 |

## 2. Risks that threaten it
All four are in RA-PFMEA-001.

| Risk | Class | Sev | Failure mode |
|---|---|---|---|
| FM-06 | HIGH | 8 | MOI below target. Cause: titer over-estimated or vector degraded. |
| FM-07 | HIGH | 8 | Vector held above -70 °C. Cause: ULT freezer failure. |
| FM-15 | HIGH | 10 | OOS result not flagged. |
| FM-08 | MEDIUM | 6 | Transduction outside 20–30 h. |

## 3. Controls and test evidence

**FM-06 (MOI below target)**
- It is mitigated by URS-EBR-007 (vector volume calculated from target MOI and CoA titer) and by SOP-MFG-104.
- URS-EBR-007 is a HIGH-risk requirement (FRA-040).
- It is verified by TC-OQ-EBR-04 (SCRIPTED) through CS-EBR-02. The test passed on 2026-03-17 (TX-0083), and no change control has touched it.
- **Gap:** the control relies on the CoA titer. If the vector loses potency, the effective MOI drops and nothing in the batch record shows it.

**FM-07 (vector held above -70 °C)**
- It is mitigated by URS-ULT-001 (hold ≤ -70 °C), URS-ULT-002 (high-temperature alarm), URS-EMS-014 (alarm escalation within 15 minutes) and SOP-MAT-401.
- All three requirements are HIGH risk.
- URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002 are verified on both freezers.
  - After the FRZ-80-02 compressor change (CC-26-014, 2026-04-23), the pull-down and alarm tests were re-run and passed on 2026-04-24 (TX-0091, TX-0092).
  - The loaded PQ (TC-PQ-ULT-01, FRZ-80-02, 2026-02-12) predates the compressor change and was not repeated.
- **Gap: URS-EMS-014 has a stale verification.**
  - Its only test is TC-OQ-EMS-04 (TX-0070, 2026-01-20).
  - CC-26-011 changed the paging provider and rebuilt the escalation recipients (CS-EMS-03) on 2026-03-16.
  - That change control was assessed as "no re-testing required", so the test predates it.
- There is also no direct test on URS-EMS-014 itself. Its evidence comes only through CS-EMS-03.

**FM-15 (OOS not flagged)**
- It is mitigated by URS-LIMS-002 and URS-LIMS-003, both HIGH risk.
- Both are verified through CS-LIMS-02 and CS-LIMS-01, with SCRIPTED tests passed on 2026-02-09 and 2026-02-10 (TX-0074, TX-0075).
- There is no change control on the LIMS.

**FM-08 (transduction timing)**
- **Gap:** it has no requirement and no test evidence.
- It is mitigated only by SOP-MFG-104 and a batch-record timing check.
- This is the only one of the four risks with no verified requirement behind it.

## 4. How it is measured and validated
- **Method:** AM-FC-CAR, CAR expression by flow cytometry, status VALIDATED, validated range 5–90 % of CD3+.
- **Validation protocol:** AMV-FC-CAR-01 was approved on 2026-03-02, with its report approved.
- **Test evidence:** TC-AMV-CAR-01 (SCRIPTED) was executed on 2026-03-20 as TX-0086 and passed.
- **Range check:** the PPQ limit (≥ 20 %) and all observed results sit inside the validated range.
- **Related quantity:** VCN per CAR+ cell is calculated in LIMS as VCN-DDPCR divided by %CAR+. The ddPCR method is AM-VCN.

## 5. PPQ performance (PPQ-001, criterion 8: ≥ 20 % of CD3+)

| Batch | %CAR+ | Vector lot | MOI | Hours to transduction | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PPQ26-01 | 44.6 | LV26-007 | 5.0 | 23.3 | PASS |
